summary.text: A neutral threat too dangerous for ordinary solo play forces the champion to learn party roles, support contribution, and trust before entering the warzone.

chapter.progressionIntent: The main spine naturally approaches level 40 through coordinated play; side quests teach but do not grant required progression.

summary.text: Form a balanced party, defeat a Veil-touched neutral threat, and prove support and protection matter as much as the killing blow.

text.text: Form a four- or five-person party with damage, protection, and sustain represented.
Track the Veil-touched pack without overpulling its camp.
Defeat the pack alpha through coordinated contribution.
Review damage, healing, buffing, protection, and objective participation.

choice.meaning: Choose a cautious or aggressive hunt plan; both require support contribution and neither permits potion-spam substitution for healers.

mainQuest.completionOutcome: The champion is judged ready for outer-warzone danger, party contribution is recognized fairly, and a Veil shard links the beasts to Edras's influence.

summary.text: Escort wounded hunters while a healer and buffer demonstrate how support contribution keeps a party alive.

mainStoryContribution.text: Makes support rewards understandable before the main hunt and shows why combat potions cannot replace active healing.

text.text: Stabilize them through healing, protection, and buffs.
Escort the group without abandoning the support players.
The party interface displays contribution explanations earlier; no required experience is granted.

title.text: The Fifth Place at the Fire

summary.text: Invite a role your group usually overlooks and listen to why each member fights before the next hunt.

sideQuests.unlockCondition: A party of at least four is formed

mainStoryContribution.text: Turns the recommended four- or five-person composition into a social choice and gives later losses and reunions emotional context.

text.text: Invite a fifth specialist or support role.
Hear each party member's reason for crossing the gate.
Choose a shared rule for retreat and recovery.
One party companion speaks for the group at the final council.
